name: month-bars
title: Month Bars
description: Spending by month: bars rise in turn, the picked month lights teal and the figure counts to it.

perf.budget: Bars use short UI-thread springs on arrival; the figure re-renders only while it counts. Nothing animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Bars appear in place and the figure changes without counting.
a11y.screenReader: The figure reads as one line ("OCT: $2,316.30, +129.11") and each month as a button with its selected state.
a11y.touchTarget: Each month is the full column, at least 44 pt tall.

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { MonthBars } from '@/components/kinetik/month-bars';

<MonthBars
  months={[
    { label: 'MAY', value: 1840.5 },
    { label: 'JUN', value: 2410.2 },
    { label: 'JUL', value: 1975.75 },
    { label: 'AUG', value: 2120 },
    { label: 'SEP', value: 2187.19 },
    { label: 'OCT', value: 2316.3 },
  ]}
/>;
```

## When to use

- Monthly totals in a banking or budgeting app.
- Six or so periods where each one can be tapped.

## When not to use

- More than about eight months: targets get too narrow.
- Precise comparisons, as bars start from a raised floor. Use Bar Chart.

## Notes

- Bars are scaled from a raised floor, so small changes are easy to see.
- The last month starts selected.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add month-bars`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
